texas.name: Texas
texas.description: The Lone Star State offers over 600 miles of Gulf Coast shoreline with diverse beaches, fishing, and coastal culture.

louisiana.name: Louisiana
louisiana.description: The Pelican State features unique bayou culture, Cajun cuisine, and diverse coastal ecosystems.

mississippi.name: Mississippi
mississippi.description: The Magnolia State offers 62 miles of Gulf Coast with casinos, beaches, and Southern hospitality.

alabama.name: Alabama
alabama.description: The Yellowhammer State features 60 miles of Gulf Coast with white sand beaches and family-friendly resorts.

florida.name: Florida
florida.description: The Sunshine State offers the longest Gulf Coast with pristine beaches, crystal clear waters, and endless recreation.
